title: Daily Routines
subject: English as a Foreign Language
instructions: Practise talking about everyday activities. Listen with the play buttons, and use the Check button as you go.

cards.example: I wake up at seven o'clock.
We have breakfast in the kitchen.
She goes to work by bus.

activities.text: Every morning I {{wake}} up at seven and {{have}} breakfast with my family.
activities.hint: Use the present simple 'I' form — no ending is added.
activities.explanation: With 'I', the present simple keeps the base verb: wake, have.

items.text: She gets up at half past six.
They do not work on Sundays.
items.hint: There is a negative in this sentence.

activities.prompt: Write three sentences about your morning routine. What time do you wake up? What do you have for breakfast?
activities.sampleAnswer: I wake up at half past six. I have coffee and toast for breakfast. Then I go to work by bus.
